This '''station''' was used as a fuel station on the bleak [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Orondia/Legends|Orondia]], within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The depot was run by a [[Unidentified Bith (Orondia station)|Bith]] who had a brother on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] that would only give them enough fuel to reach Orondia at the depot to scam people. The depot was later visited by a disguised [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] to supply their ship with fuel after escaping from Nal Hutta. As the three fugitives fueled their ship, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] came to the depot in search of the criminals.
